text: Centred filters require a Frame and explicit WindowObservationPolicy. RequireTracked excludes off-surface neighbours; IncludeOffScreen admits known off-surface positions; either policy preserves a centre when any position is missing. Savitzky-Golay additionally requires RegularSampling parsed from exact timestamps; the machine rechecks each window and preserves it if a proof is misbound. Filtered positions inside the frame preserve centre pupil and become SampleOrigin.Smoothed; overshoots become Gaze.OffScreen and therefore explicitly carry no pupil. Interpolation is SampleOrigin.Interpolated and recording warps are SampleOrigin.Projected.
